author: Hermes
question: A 4-pole, 50 Hz three-phase induction motor runs at 1440 rpm on full load. What is its full-load slip?
solution: Synchronous speed Ns = 120f/P = 120 x 50/4 = 1500 rpm. Slip = (Ns - N)/Ns = (1500 - 1440)/1500 = 60/1500 = 0.04 (4%). Topic (induction machines) is in the Electrical Machines section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
